cohort: 19 pregnant women (31 pregnancies) with Marfan syndrome
finding: In a cohort of pregnant women with Marfan syndrome, the authors found that a multidisciplinary team approach to anesthetic management during labor is optimal.
mod_finding: Of the 20 deliveries in the non-high-risk group (aortic root diameter <40mm), 14 were vaginal deliveries, 9 with epidural analgesia and 5 without; in the high risk group (aortic root diameter 40-46mm), 5 patients had elective caesarean section, 2 under general anesthesia and 3 under spinal anesthesia.
